description: A contrast grid for your whole palette — every pairing checked against WCAG. A HelpySelf tool (helpyself.com).

level.description: The WCAG grade a pairing must clear to count as passing: AA is 4.5:1, AA_LARGE is 3:1, AAA is 7:1, AAA_LARGE is 4.5:1. Every cell still reports its own ratio and grade; this only decides the pass count. Defaults to AA.

palette.description: The colours to check against each other, as hex, rgb(), hsl() or CSS colour names, separated by newlines, commas or spaces. CSS custom-property names are ignored, duplicates are dropped, and 2 to 24 distinct colours are needed.

name: contrast_grid
title: Contrast Grid
